en:
His white half's whiter than freshly made rice!
His black half's blacker than the darkest night!

You actually came.
Hmm, so I guess I'm allowed to do this, huh?

Is it really okay for me to talk to you in
private like this?
Technically, it's not a rule violation...

Besides, I can't pass up an opportunity
to make the killing game more exciting.
Riiight? I was thinking the same thing!

This fun and vicious killing game is the
only thing on my mind!

With that said, you're not even gonna try
and use <CLT=cltSTRONG>that motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

A crazy <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL> like this should be used in
a more...dramatic way, no?

That's what I've been thinking, so I tried
coming up with ways to use it...

And I finally came up with an idea.
So, this is my proposal...

A <CLT=cltSTRONG>certain someone<CLT=cltNORMAL> is planning something
interesting, so if we use the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL> there...

Then I think that would reeeeally spice up
the game. So, are you in?
Puhuhu. You really are an evil bastard.

Of course... I *am* the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Supreme
Leader<CLT=cltNORMAL>, y'know?

I will drag this world into the pits of terror,
using my villainous power to commit <CLT=cltSTRONG>evil<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
